info.title: Campbooks API

bearer.description:
An OAuth 2.1 access token (a JWT) issued by this instance's identity provider, the issuer configured as `CAMPBOOKS_AUTH__ISSUER`. Each operation lists the scope it requires; operations with an empty requirement are public. Scopes:

- `conversations:read`: Read your inboxes, conversations and messages.
- `conversations:write`: Mark conversations read or unread, star, archive, label and move them between streams.
- `system:read`: Read operational status.
- `workspaces:admin`: Manage workspaces you own or administer: settings, members, invitations, deletion and the security log.
- `workspaces:read`: See your workspaces and who belongs to them.
- `workspaces:write`: Create workspaces, accept invitations and leave workspaces.

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces, members and roles, invitations and the security log. Workspace-owned resources live under `/api/v1/w/{workspace_id}/`; a caller who is not a member (or a client token bound to another workspace) gets 404.

tags.name: conversations
tags.description: Inboxes, conversations and messages on any channel (email first), sorted into streams. Workspace-owned: a user sees the inboxes they are a member of; a client token bound to the workspace sees them all.
